novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a shared board
novel_policies.quote: Four individuals licensed as optometrists under this chapter; Two individuals licensed as licensed dispensing opticians under this chapter; One individual representing the general public.

novel_policies.label: does not authorize anaphylaxis treatment
novel_policies.quote: The administration of medication by injection.

novel_policies.label: does not require comanagement with ophthalmologist
novel_policies.quote: Nothing in this section or any other provision of law shall be construed to prohibit optometrists who have been certified under Sections 73-19-153 through 73-19-165 from providing postophthalmic surgical or clinical care and management with the advice and consultation of the operating or treating physician.

novel_policies.label: does not authorize delegation to unlicensed assistants
novel_policies.quote: a licensee may not delegate the authority to administer pharmaceutical agents by injection to any other person

novel_policies.label: does not authorize foreign body removal
novel_policies.quote: Invasive modality includes surgery, lasers, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound and the removal of foreign bodies from within the tissue of the eye.

novel_policies.label: does not require jurisprudence exam
novel_policies.quote: Nothing contained in this section shall preclude a board from requiring an applicant for licensure based on an out-of-State license to take an on-line jurisprudence course or an orientation available to the applicant at any time.

novel_policies.label: does not authorize minor surgical procedures
novel_policies.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include any injection or invasive modality.

novel_policies.label: comanagement with ophthalmologist required
novel_policies.quote: Treatment with topical and oral medications authorized in subdivision (a) related to an ocular surgery shall be comanaged with the ophthalmologist that performed the surgery

novel_policies.label: dea registration required
novel_policies.quote: require that a licensee who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database

novel_policies.label: glaucoma treatment authorized
novel_policies.quote: If also certified under subdivision (c), using or prescribing topical and oral antiglaucoma agents for the medical treatment of all primary open-angle, exfoliation, pigmentary, and steroid-induced glaucomas in persons 18 years of age or over.

novel_policies.label: home visit permit required
novel_policies.quote: An optometrist who is certified as a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent pursuant to Section 3041.3 may ... submit an application to the board for a home residence permit

novel_policies.label: immunization authority
novel_policies.quote: independent initiation and administration of immunizations for influenza, herpes zoster virus, pneumococcus, and SARS-CoV-2 ... in persons 18 years of age or over.

novel_policies.label: laser procedures authorized
novel_policies.quote: The 'practice of optometry' includes the following procedures: ... Laser capsulotomy; and Laser trabeculoplasty.

novel_policies.label: limited teaching license available
novel_policies.quote: The board may, under rules and regulations to be promulgated by the board, issue limited licenses, in the case of teachers, to persons who hold an optometric degree where such persons are not licensed and registered to practice optometry in this state.

novel_policies.label: maximum number of offices
novel_policies.quote: No optometrist, and no two or more optometrists jointly, may have more than 11 offices.

novel_policies.label: minor surgical procedures authorized
novel_policies.quote: Injections, excluding intravenous or intraocular injections; Incision and curettage of a chalazion; Removal and biopsy of skin lesions with low risk of malignancy

novel_policies.label: mobile office authorized
novel_policies.quote: 'mobile optometric office' means a trailer, van, or other means of transportation in which the practice of optometry, as defined in Section 3041, is performed

novel_policies.label: opioid prescription day limit
novel_policies.quote: A licensee may not issue an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a four-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use.

novel_policies.label: patient record retention years
novel_policies.quote: An optometrist shall retain a patient's records for a minimum of seven years from the date he or she completes treatment of the patient.

novel_policies.label: lacks immunization authority
novel_policies.quote: Except as provided in subsection F of this section, substances administered by injection.

novel_policies.label: supervised clinical internship required
novel_policies.quote: Served an internship program established by the board, supervised and certified by a board-certified ophthalmologist, which internship includes at least one hundred (100) hours of supervised clinical training

novel_policies.label: telemedicine authorized
novel_policies.quote: TELEMEDICINE. A health service that is delivered by a licensed optometrist acting within the scope of his or her license and that requires the use of advanced telecommunications technology

novel_policies.label: tiered license types
novel_policies.quote: Beginning July 1, 2003, the board will issue licenses only for optometric physicians to persons who meet the requirements of this section

novel_policies.label: anaphylaxis treatment authorized
novel_policies.quote: The practice of optometry shall include the authority to administer benedryl, epinephrine, or other medication to counteract anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reaction.

novel_policies.label: contact lens prescription expiration years
novel_policies.quote: A written contact lens prescription shall expire one (1) year after the date of the completion of the contact lens fitting unless there is a medical reason that warrants a prescription for less than one (1) year.

novel_policies.label: criminal background check required
novel_policies.quote: Application to the Identification Bureau of the Division of Arkansas State Police for a state and national criminal background check, to be conducted by the Federal Bureau of Investigation, which shall include the taking of fingerprints.

novel_policies.label: delegation to unlicensed assistants authorized
novel_policies.quote: authorizing an optometrist licensed under this chapter to delegate routine services of optometry to an agent of the optometrist

novel_policies.label: impaired practitioner program established
novel_policies.quote: IMPAIRED DOCTOR OF OPTOMETRY TREATMENT PROGRAM. The Alabama Board of Optometry approved or sponsored program for the detection, intervention, and monitoring of impaired providers.

novel_policies.label: retired license status available
novel_policies.quote: On retiring from practice and on payment of an appropriate one-time fee, a licensee in good standing with the board may apply for the conversion of an active or inactive license to a retired status license.

novel_policies.label: spectacle prescription release required
novel_policies.quote: the optometrist or physician practicing as an ophthalmologist shall upon request of the patient provide to the patient a complete and accurate written prescription at no additional charge.

novel_policies.label: surgery definition
novel_policies.quote: 'ophthalmic surgery' means an invasive procedure in which human tissue is cut, ablated, or otherwise penetrated by incision, laser, or other means to treat diseases of the human eye, alter or correct refractive error, or alter or enhance cosmetic appearance

novel_policies.label: jurisprudence exam required
novel_policies.quote: Has passed a written examination approved by the board that is designed to test the applicant's knowledge of the laws of Alaska governing the practice of optometry

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: There shall be within the Department of Public Health a Connecticut Board of Examiners for Optometrists.

novel_policies.label: requires post degree experience
novel_policies.quote: Served an internship program established by the board, supervised and certified by a board-certified ophthalmologist, which internship includes at least one hundred (100) hours of supervised clinical training

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: There shall be within the Department of Public Health a Connecticut Board of Examiners for Optometrists.

novel_policies.label: oral pharmaceutical authority
novel_policies.quote: A licensee may prescribe, dispense and administer the following oral prescription pharmaceuticals for treating diseases of the eye and its adnexa

novel_policies.label: pharmaceutical certification required
novel_policies.quote: The use and prescribing of pharmaceutical agents for the treatment of the human eye and its adjacent structures shall be limited to those optometrists approved by the board.

novel_policies.label: pharmacology training hours required
novel_policies.quote: a nontopical therapeutic pharmaceutical agent course of at least 23 hours approved by the board or an examination approved by the board on the treatment and management of ocular disease

novel_policies.label: does not prohibit surgery
novel_policies.quote: A licensee may not perform ophthalmic surgery unless the procedure is (1) within the scope of the licensee's education and training from an accredited school of optometry; and (2) authorized by regulations adopted by the board.

novel_policies.label: referral to physician required
novel_policies.quote: failed to refer a patient to a physician after ascertaining the presence of ocular or systemic conditions requiring management by a physician

novel_policies.label: specialty certification types
novel_policies.quote: In order to be certified to use therapeutic pharmaceutical agents and authorized to diagnose and treat the conditions listed in subdivisions (b) and (d) of Section 3041, an optometrist shall apply for a certificate from the board

novel_policies.label: vision therapy authorized
novel_policies.quote: the providing of developmental and perceptual therapy for the vision system

novel_policies.label: controlled substance schedule restrictions
novel_policies.quote: Optometrists are excluded from possessing, administering, or prescribing those pharmaceutical agents listed in Schedules I and II of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act, except hydrocodone combination drugs, regardless of their schedule, in combination with oral analgesic drugs.

novel_policies.label: foreign body removal authorized
novel_policies.quote: A licensee may remove superficial foreign bodies from the eye and its appendages. This section is not intended to permit a licensee to perform invasive surgery.

novel_policies.label: surgery prohibited
novel_policies.quote: Optometrists are prohibited from performing injections into the eyeball, cataract surgery, muscle surgery, retinal surgery, radial keratotomy, laser surgery, cryosurgery, or any other invasive surgery.

novel_policies.label: does not require pharmaceutical certification
novel_policies.quote: A licensee may prescribe and use a pharmaceutical agent, including a controlled substance, in the practice of optometry if the pharmaceutical agent is used in a manner consistent with standards adopted by the board in regulation.
